title: Israel Detonates Explosives Around Bint Jbeil in Second Consecutive Night of Demolitions
detail: Israeli forces carried out a massive controlled detonation around the city of Bint Jbeil on Thursday, the second consecutive night of large demolitions in the sector after Tuesday's Khiam blast. Overnight artillery hit Beit Yahoun, Shaqra, Kounine, Hadatha and al-Mansouri, while airstrikes struck Mayfadoun, al-Mansouri, al-Qantara, Wadi al-Hujair and Wadi Slouqi; Israeli forces also set off a second night of detonations in al-Khiam. No casualties were reported.
